competing_trace_defects.description: Confirming the copy created an invoice_2025_001 (1).pdf duplicate in Downloads without any visible selection of Finance/invoice as the destination.

chains.rationale: The reused observation incorrectly said the completed search had not executed, but the reuse target's click visibly opens the navigation drawer from Downloads. That action is concurrent with the incorrect history rather than an observable preservation or creation of a placement defect. No later screen visibly shows Finance/invoice or the required file in that destination.

summary: The sole reused-history target opened navigation despite the erroneous search-status observation; the trace separately shows a source-directory duplicate created during copy confirmation, while destination placement remains unobserved.
